criteria.safety: all complete and independently validated; all failures retained
criteria.primary: mean paired per-instance relative F improvement vs same SIPP/no-joint G0; positive is better
criteria.economy: if CPU ratio >3 and paired F improvement <0.5%, do not replace simple fallback
criteria.tail: report all P90/max-response degradations; existing defaults remain unchanged
criteria.inference: fixed-template percentile bootstrap; not an unseen-map or global-optimality guarantee
